text_block_list.text:
Hearing rumors that Mejiro McQueen wasn't 
feeling well, Mejiro Ryan rushed over to 
see her.

However, paying no heed to Mejiro Ryan's 
concern, she declared she was in top form. 
She then proposed a mock race to prove it.

Accepting the challenge, Mejiro Ryan was 
shown her overwhelming aptitude for long 
distances.

Seeing Mejiro McQueen build her strength 
for the Tenno Sho (Spring) beyond the 
Classics, Mejiro Ryan begins to feel an 
underlying sense of impatience.
